summary: Aon plc filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 on September 11, 2026, disclosing other events and financial statements/exhibits. The filing lists the registrant's Class A ordinary shares and numerous guaranteed senior notes across maturities from 2027 to 2054, all NYSE-listed, but the excerpt contains no transaction terms, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation. This is an ordinary current report, not a special situation, so no deal terms can be extracted or analyzed.
